paragraphs: Projectodo is your musicians manager, your sound equipment rental service and recording studio for your music productions.

Family celebrations, jubilees, inaugurations, weddings — we arrange your events with experienced musicians, whether as a duet, trio, quartet or quintet. We offer you the best service so that your party becomes a success.
intro.claim: ...simply contact us, we'll take care of the rest!

sections.title: Lessons
sections.body: From small children to seniors, we offer music lessons for all levels and ages. Our teachers are professional musicians with long experience in teaching. One-to-one or small groups; in-person or online or online

sections.title: Bands
sections.body: We can provide you with talented and experienced musicians for any type of occasion! From solo to sextet and also larger bands on request.

sections.title: Production
sections.body: We offer clients high quality recording equipment that suits all needs of professional work.

sections.title: Technical
sections.body: No matter whether advertising, speech or music recording — besides our equipment, we provide you with our experience.
